i'm trying to sort out next week's rehearsal, but the studio room we use on thursday has been marked unavailable that evening because of the heating work. so we need to figure out another arrangement, although i don't know yet whether the work might finish early or if there's any chance the room could be opened again. I don't want us to plan around that, though. One possibility is asking whether we can move to Wednesday evening and use the same studio; I haven't checked whether that time is free. The other is staying with Thursday but seeing if the smaller room downstairs can be used instead. I'm not sure it has enough space for everyone and all the stands, and we'd need to find out whether the piano can be moved or is already in there. Those are the two options I can think of right now, but I haven't asked anyone to book either one, and we haven't settled on which would work better. If people have a preference, let me know, but I don't think we should treat either plan as decided until we know what's actually possible. Wednesday would mean changing the night for everyone, while the smaller room might mean adjusting how we set up, so both options need checking before we make plans.
